build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two balls must touch despite obstacles using define_task_template decorator
add_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls with configurable x positions and fixed bottom placement using C.add and set_center_x
add_obstacle_bars: add static horizontal and vertical bars forming an obstacle structure with configurable bar_y and obstacle_width
add_ramps: add angled ramp bars at -10 and 10 degrees to guide ball movement using C.add with angle parameter
update_task_goal: define the task goal requiring two balls to touch using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING and SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS
